instruction: Candid documentary wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet. The man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, facing right, shaking right hands with the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) who stands on the right facing left. Even overhead lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the neutral tones and the red floor.
elements: R1 is the male participant whose right hand is clasped with R2's right hand
R2 is the female participant receiving the right-hand clasp from R1
R1 faces toward R2 while R2 faces back toward R1 during the hand contact
R1 and R2 make contact specifically with their right hands
the interaction occurs in an indoor motion capture studio
